items.requirement: Jointly redesign the complete stdlib API/layout, map old-to-new contracts and requalify migrated consumers
items.notes: Maintainer explicitly chose whole-API/layout redesign, compact std namespace, constructors on types, the current source root, usize memory size/index and supplemental fallible allocation (STD-D06), then authorized implementation. STABLE-017 tracks the first ABI 2 / Vec / Box / String allocation slice. The parser inventory remains the immutable pre-redesign snapshot; the added alloc_error provider makes 50 current providers. Per-domain contracts, the remaining old-to-new ownership and size/index map, implementation and fresh source/artifact/package qualification remain open. On 2026-10-22 the maintainer requested a functional comparison against C++ and basic CPU math/graph/matrix/tensor in stdlib, with advanced functionality in local/vendored libraries. The foundation slice migrates usize memory APIs and adds type constructors, ordered-set algebra and u64 bit utilities; broader families and final qualification remain open. Implementation pin 28802f12 passes focused Windows eight CLI suites (29 tests), 40 existing acceptance tests and all 50 canonical LLIB/object inspections. The fresh parser snapshot has 2,411 declarations and 219 explicit imports, not a resolved API catalog. Full platform/workspace/package gates remain open; no release completion is claimed. On 2026-10-23 the maintainer prioritized clear I/O design before numerical/graph expansion and selected $variable interpolation instead of {} placeholders. The I/O and generic interpolation proposals define target API/semantics only; detailed policies and macro capability remain unimplemented and are not release qualification. The maintainer then requested a complete lang-item design: 22 current production keys are distinguished from a 26-role core target and disabled optional profiles. This is design-only; optional roadmap identities are not automatically stable 0.1.0 requirements or supported features.
